summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the pricing of USD 1 billion 5-year senior unsecured fixed-rate notes under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. The notes carry a 5.410% coupon, mature August 27, 2031, and are rated Baa3 by Moody's and BBB by S&P. This is a routine debt issuance for general corporate purposes, not a special situation. The notes will be listed on IFSC exchanges and SGX-ST. Allotment is set for August 27, 2026.
